# Substrings that disqualify a model from provider-side structured output even when the
# model family would otherwise be supported (e.g. OpenAI "-pro" reasoning variants,
# open-weight "-oss-" models, and image/video generation models).
_UNSUPPORTED_MODEL_MARKERS = ("imagine", "-image", "-video")

# Matches Anthropic Claude model names of the form ``claude-<family>-<major>[-<minor>]``,
# optionally prefixed with a provider namespace (e.g. ``anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5``).
_CLAUDE_VERSION_PATTERN = re.compile(r"claude-[a-z]+-(\d+)(?:[-.](\d+))?")

# Minimum Claude generation (major, minor) that supports provider-side structured output.
_MIN_CLAUDE_VERSION = (4, 5)


def _model_name_supports_provider_strategy(model_name: str) -> bool:
    """Determine provider-strategy support from a model name string alone.

    Used as a fallback when structured model profile data is unavailable.

    Args:
        model_name: The model name to inspect.

    Returns:
        `True` if the named model is expected to support provider-side structured output.
    """
    name = model_name.lower()
